description: The plot, titled "Hidden State Mean," illustrates the evolution of the absolute mean of hidden states across different layers in a neural network, comparing the mean before and after a gating mechanism. The x-axis represents the "Layer," ranging from 0 to 22, with tick marks at intervals of 5, indicating the depth of the network. The y-axis, labeled "Abs Mean," measures the absolute mean of the hidden states, with values ranging from 0 to 4. Three distinct lines are plotted: a dashed blue line representing the "hidden state mean before gate," which shows a gradual increase from approximately 0.1 to 4.4; a dotted orange line for the "hidden state mean after gate," which remains nearly flat at a very low value of around 0.05; and a solid green line for the "hidden state," which is also nearly flat, hovering just above 0. The legend indicates that the average mean before the gate is 0.71, while the average after the gate is 0.05, highlighting the significant reduction in magnitude caused by the gate. The plot demonstrates that the gating mechanism effectively suppresses the hidden state mean, particularly in deeper layers.
